dct_description_sm:
This is designed to provide the public with information regarding inspections of all geographically fixed recreational camps in Waterloo Region. Please be advised that the results of all inspections posted here describe what the Public Health Inspector (PHI) observed on the date of inspection. This data is not intended to guarantee the conditions of a recreational camps premise at all times and should not be relied upon for that purpose.

No endorsement of any recreational camp premises, or the products or services offered by a recreational camp premise, is expressed or implied by any information, material or content included in this data.
